Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The error occurred because the agent failed to correctly extract the specific text from the official script source it had just accessed. Despite successfully navigating to the BBC Writers Room PDF (Step 9) and attempting to summarize the page (Step 10), the agent hallucinated the location name as "Teleport chamber room." This is factually incorrect; the first scene heading in the official script for "Heaven Sent" is "The TARDIS." The agent's failure to accurately read or parse the PDF content, leading to a confident but wrong answer, constitutes a data extraction and hallucination error.
